staff.name: Martin Flynn
staff.basis: The staffing model puts 1 of this role in a forwarding and commission house at the typical band and 2 at the high end, on directory_1839. 41 teamsters and 30 draymen in 1839, against a river trade this one grew out of. This person is a reconstructed resident of the trade with no workplace of their own; the house is one the business layer already holds, and this row points at it rather than raising anything.
